name: Harness Turn and Artifact Integrity
area: Owns harness_turn behavior, turn artifacts, witness event identity, and turn-facing run path bugs.
audit_basis: Matched queued BUG IDs against regression tests in tests/test_bug*.py.

items.title: Turn artifacts do not faithfully record the model-facing input
`harness_turn.py` can emit unstable `event_id` values for semantically identical deterministic runs
`harness_turn.py` artifacts are not self-describing for env-only backend-error exposure and fault-injection runs
